records.evidence_source_family: JRA monthly News index plus explicit meeting-cancellation articles
records.notes: Production discovers bounded candidate notices from the official monthly JRA News index, parses only explicit whole-meeting cancellation wording, binds venue/date to an existing canonical meeting, rejects race-only cancellation wording, and fails closed on notice-fetch failure. Replacement dates remain independent meetings.

records.evidence_source_family: No single normalized nationwide NAR whole-meeting negative-evidence route proven
records.notes: Individual local organizers can publish cancellation notices, but a safe nationwide authority-normalized route has not yet been proven. Retain on absence.

records.evidence_source_family: Banei Tokachi monthly TOPICS archive plus explicit cancellation articles
records.notes: Production scans bounded official monthly TOPICS archive pages for cancellation-related candidate articles, accepts only whole-day/multi-day Banei cancellation evidence, rejects partial-race stoppages and external-racing notices, binds evidence to existing canonical meetings, and fails closed on archive/article fetch failure.

records.evidence_source_family: HKJC official fixture page final-announcement cancellation text
records.notes: The already-collected official monthly fixture page is parsed only for an explicit whole-meeting sentence ('The race meeting originally scheduled ... will be/has been/is cancelled'). Race-only cancellation wording is rejected. Confirmed records are emitted into the rolling artifact and durably persisted before public suppression.

The already-collected official racecard/declarations route is parsed only for the exact whole-meeting status 'THIS MEETING HAS BEEN CANCELLED'. Race-only wording is rejected. Confirmed records are emitted into the rolling artifact and durably persisted before public suppression.

records.notes: KRA exposes race-level changes and official operating plans, but this audit did not prove a stable machine-readable whole-meeting cancellation/postponement route. Retain verified meetings on absence.
